problem_schema.category: enum: PRODUCT_CODE | PUBLIC_API | API_NAMING | API_USABILITY | CLASS_SEGREGATION | OBJECT_MODEL | PARSER | WRITER | EDIT_WORKFLOW | SAVE_ROUNDTRIP | EXPORT_DOGFOOD | FEATURE_AVAILABILITY | FEATURE_COMPLEXITY | FEATURE_COMPREHENSIVENESS | ERROR_HANDLING | EDGE_CASES | TEST_COVERAGE | TEST_MEANINGFULNESS | EXAMPLES_DOCS | PACKAGING | END_USER_WORKFLOW | CLAIM_OVERREACH | COMMERCIAL_READINESS | FOSS_READINESS
problem_schema.description: string — clear description of the problem
problem_schema.evidence: string — file paths or specific evidence supporting the finding
problem_schema.estimated_effort: enum: XS | S | M | L | XL
problem_schema.blocks_release: boolean — does this block any commercial release?
problem_schema.status: enum: OPEN | IN_PROGRESS | RESOLVED | DEFERRED | WONT_FIX

problems.description: Wildcard star-imports in __init__.py — uncontrolled namespace surface
problems.evidence: src/python/fods/__init__.py: from .parser import *; from .neutral_model import *; ...
problems.recommended_fix: Replace wildcard imports with explicit imports; maintain curated __all__ list

problems.description: Dual API: dict-function API AND class-based API both exported with no guidance
problems.evidence: src/python/fods/__init__.py exports both parse_fods() dict functions AND FodsDocument class
problems.recommended_fix: Designate class-based API as primary; deprecate or hide dict-function API; document the choice

problems.description: All examples use dev-path imports (sys.path.insert + src.python.fods), not installed-package imports
problems.evidence: examples/python/fods/edit_save_fods.py: sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO_ROOT)); from src.python.fods import ...
problems.recommended_fix: Update all examples to use installed-package imports; add sys.path fallback for dev environment

problems.description: pyproject.toml missing: authors, [project.urls], keywords, classifiers, readme for all 20 packages
problems.evidence: src/python/fods/pyproject.toml has only name, version, description, license, requires-python
problems.recommended_fix: Add authors, urls (Homepage, Repository), keywords, classifiers, readme to all 20 pyproject.toml files

problems.description: README.md missing at src/net/{format}/. All csproj files reference it via PackageReadmeFile = README.md
problems.evidence: src/net/fods/FormatFactory.Fods.csproj: <PackageReadmeFile>README.md</PackageReadmeFile>; file does not exist
problems.recommended_fix: Create README.md at each src/net/{format}/ directory with basic overview and code examples

problems.description: csproj PackageDescription says 'Gate 11 approved 2026-06-05' but source header says 'NOT approved'
problems.evidence: FormatFactory.Fods.csproj PackageDescription vs FodsDocument.cs line 2: Gate 11 contradiction
problems.recommended_fix: Update csproj PackageDescription to reflect actual status: 'Gate 11 pending; commercial readiness in progress'

problems.description: No compress/decompress/write capability. ZstDocument is pure read-only DTO. No ZstWriter class.
problems.evidence: src/net/zst/ZstDocument.cs: all properties are init-only. No ZstWriter.cs file. ZstParser.Parse() only entry point.
problems.recommended_fix: Add ZstWriter class with Compress(Stream/byte[]) and Decompress(byte[]) methods

problems.description: No Load(Stream) overload. NdjsonDocument and NetpbmDocument have stream load; FODS and FODT don't.
problems.evidence: FodsDocument.Load(string filePath) — no stream overload. NdjsonDocument.Load(Stream stream) exists.
problems.recommended_fix: Add FodsDocument.Load(Stream stream) and FodtDocument.Load(Stream stream)

problems.description: Read-only product with no write_fodp(). Limitation not documented. consumer_roundtrip.py name is misleading.
problems.evidence: src/python/fodp/fodp_codec.py: no write_fodp function. examples/python/fodp/consumer_roundtrip.py exists.
problems.recommended_fix: Either: (a) add write_fodp() capability, OR (b) add write_fodp() stub raising NotImplementedError('FODP write not yet supported') and rename example to consumer_inspect.py

problems.description: NdjsonDocument holds raw List<JsonElement>. JsonElement leaks into public API. No typed NdjsonRecord class.
problems.evidence: src/net/ndjson/NdjsonDocument.cs: private List<JsonElement> _records; public IReadOnlyList<JsonElement> Records
problems.recommended_fix: Add NdjsonRecord typed wrapper class; expose as IReadOnlyList<NdjsonRecord>

problems.description: NdjsonDocument.Load(string content) — 'content' parameter name suggests content string but looks like file path
problems.evidence: src/net/ndjson/NdjsonDocument.cs: Load(string content) vs LoadFile(string path)
problems.recommended_fix: Rename Load(string content) to LoadFromContent(string ndjsonContent)

problems.description: Spec/Table/* files exist but are architecture stubs. Table operations may NOT be wired to FodtDocument public API.
problems.evidence: src/net/fodt/Spec/Table/Table.cs, TableCell.cs, TableRow.cs — architecture-only stubs
problems.recommended_fix: Verify FodtDocument public API for table operations; if not present, add AddTable()/RemoveTable(); remove stubs if redundant

problems.description: NetpbmExporter is within-family only (PBM→PGM, PBM→PPM). Scope not documented.
problems.evidence: src/net/netpbm/NetpbmExporter.cs: static class NetpbmExporter with PbmToPgm, PbmToPpm methods only
problems.recommended_fix: Add XML doc comment to NetpbmExporter class: 'Provides within-family format conversion (PBM to PGM, PBM to PPM). Not an external format exporter.'

problems.description: No README.md for any Python or .NET product. Only PBM/PGM/PPM have docs/api/*.md files.
problems.evidence: Confirmed by source inspection: no README.md at src/net/{format}/ or src/python/{format}/
problems.recommended_fix: Create README.md for each product with: overview, installation, quickstart code example, API reference, links

problems.description: HTML, Markdown, TXT are internal writer helpers. Listed as standalone products in registry.
problems.evidence: src/net/html/HtmlWriter.cs — single file writer helper. No Load/Save/Document class.
problems.recommended_fix: Re-classify as internal helpers in registry; do not market as standalone products; document their role

problems.description: src/python/_shared/_base_codec.py and _base_parser.py exist but are not used by most format packages. Dead abstraction.
problems.evidence: Most format __init__.py files do not import from _shared/
problems.recommended_fix: Either: (a) delete _shared/ if truly unused, OR (b) make all format packages inherit from base classes

problems.description: Test files named by sprint (FodsR87ProductDeepening.cs) not by feature. ~60-80% sprint-named.
problems.evidence: tests/net/fods/ contains files like FodsR87ProductDeepening.cs, FodsR100AddSheetTests.cs
problems.recommended_fix: Rename test files to feature-based names (FodsSheetCrudTests.cs, FodsCellStyleTests.cs)

problems.description: FodsDocument.GetColumnHeaders() has 3 overloads including static variant. No other FodsDocument methods are static.
problems.evidence: src/net/fods/FodsDocument.cs: static overload of GetColumnHeaders() breaks instance-method convention
problems.recommended_fix: Remove static overload; provide only instance method; use extension method if needed

problems.description: No [project.scripts] CLI entry points in any pyproject.toml. Cannot use Format Factory from command line.
problems.evidence: src/python/fods/pyproject.toml: no [project.scripts] section
problems.recommended_fix: Add CLI entry points to key packages: fods, fodt, pbm, pgm, ppm, zst at minimum

problems.description: No type stubs (.pyi files) for any Python package. Poor IDE support.
problems.evidence: No .pyi files found under src/python/
problems.recommended_fix: Generate .pyi stub files for all public APIs using stubgen or manual authoring
